prompt: A game art part sheet shows one young eastern dragon taken apart into six separate pieces laid out in a tidy grid with clear gaps between them: the head with branching antlers and long whiskers, a long curved body segment, one short clawed front leg, one short clawed hind leg, a tufted tail, and a strip of flowing golden mane. Proportions are stylised with a large head, a compact body and chunky claws, and large bright eyes give it a bold, friendly look. The pieces sit apart from each other with space between every one. Plain flat solid magenta background, nothing else behind the subject.
